Tape les lettres ou clique dessus · Reto: Type the letters or click them · Backspace: remove · Space: shuffle · Tab: hint · Escape: pause
Les lettres d'un mot ont été mélangées :: The letters of a word have been mixed up: put them back in order. Each level has 5 words, and words get longer every two levels, from 4 to 9 letters. Another word using all the letters counts too. A hint places the next letter but costs points; time left earns points.
